author: Khan Academy
description:
MCAT prep can feel like a maze of resources. One trusted option can help you focus on the concepts that need another pass.

Khan Academy MCAT Prep is free, self-paced, and developed in collaboration with the AAMC.  It’s also designed to align with the MCAT Official Content Outline. Use it alongside your broader study plan to review foundational concepts, strengthen areas that need more attention, and check your understanding with practice questions.
title: Free MCAT Support
